summary: Issue #561 MMU-8: intent-review spec_fidelity=pass consumed as given. webhook_tiktok.py and auth_tiktok.py thinned to HTTP adapters delegating to services.webhook.handle_tiktok_webhook_delivery and services.tiktok.oauth public entrypoints; ETL/OAuth assembly moved to services/webhook/deployed.py and oauth.py. AST import-boundary contract in test_api_route_public_entrypoints.py; 46 related pytest cases pass. No reliability/security/observability/performance blockers.

criticalFindings.description: Intent-review smell (non-blocking): uncommitted diff adds MMU-4, MMU-7, and MMU-8 routing blocks (+114 lines); only MMU-8 belongs to issue #561.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Split MMU-4/MMU-7 routing additions into their owning issue PRs to keep harness slice-routing diffs path-disjoint.

criticalFindings.description: Implementation assumption (non-blocking): business advertiser/account-holder auth routes still assemble OAuth clients inline; only auth_tiktok.py thinned per issue requiredModules though AC #2 wording is plural.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Track follow-up MMU slice to thin auth_tiktok_business_* routes similarly.

criticalFindings.description: AST import scan only detects static import/from statements; dynamic __import__ or importlib usage in routes would evade the thin-adapter contract test.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Accept for MMU-8; extend with import-linter forbidden_edge checks (#552/#556) for defense in depth.

criticalFindings.description: _dlq_handoff relocated from route wiring logs webhook_etl_dlq but does not enqueue to a durable DLQ — pre-existing degradation path, not a #561 regression.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Track durable DLQ wiring under ingestion/ETL reliability slice if webhook loss on ETL failure becomes operational concern.

criticalFindings.description: complete_tiktok_oauth_callback allows missing OAuth state (logs tiktok_oauth_callback_missing_state, proceeds without user_id binding) — pre-existing TikTok Partner Center compatibility behavior preserved after route thinning.
criticalFindings.suggestion: Document as accepted Partner Center edge case; tighten only if TikTok mandates state on all callbacks.

interfaceChanges.description: Public entrypoint for main-API TikTok webhook ingress; re-exported from services.webhook __init__.
Factory and callback orchestration extracted from auth_tiktok route for thin-adapter pattern.

mappings.criterion: Webhook route only wires HTTP → owning webhook/TikTok service public API.
Auth TikTok callback routes call OAuth/store facade; no direct integrations.tiktok leaf imports in routes (use facade from #557).
Route files do not import services.etl.consumer internals directly.
Existing webhook/auth tests still pass; add/adjust one test asserting router uses public service entrypoints.

recommendations: Split MMU-4/MMU-7 slice-routing blocks out of #561 PR when convenient
Plan follow-up to thin auth_tiktok_business_* routes
Rely on import-linter forbidden_edge gates (#552/#556) alongside AST route contract tests
